name: questionpunk
description: Create and review survey drafts, publish requested studies, and analyze authorized QuestionPunk results.

interface.longDescription: Connect your QuestionPunk account to create saved survey drafts, refine questions, review studies, and analyze results you can access. Before you sign in, Codex can still draft a survey and give you a link that opens it in QuestionPunk. Publication requires your explicit request.
defaultPrompt: Create a short customer feedback survey and keep it unpublished.
Review my onboarding study for unclear or leading questions.
Summarize my study results with sample sizes and supporting evidence.
